text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Prosecutors boycott the ceremony to appoint the new head of the Supreme Court.
- (IU's leader) Anguita to punish Nueva Izquierda for not voting against the Labour reform pact.
EL MUNDO
- Supreme court claim Fungairino and (previuos PM) Gonzalez called him "captain of the mutinous".
- Nueva Izquierda breaks with discipline and Aguita calls for sanctions.
- Barca football club says Ronaldo cannot be transferred. It has FIFA's backing.
- (Ex financier) Conde's wife accused Navalon of false testimony and asked to investigate in Switzerland
CINCO DIAS
- Banks gain from (public financing of) mortage cake
- OCP, Gines-Navarro up 15 percent in Bourse after merger
- PM Aznar says unemployment fell by 50,000 in May
- New fast railway between Barcelona and Alicante to run at 111 km/hour.
EXPANSION
- The government makes State's contracts for buying goods and services more flexible
- Spanish Banco Urquijo in a deal with IBM Espana for 25 billion pesetas
- Bankoa will study Credit Agricole's offer.
- Basque region Economy Minister is preparing a reform of the income tax law in the area, to be ready in 1998.
- German, French economies are not showing clear signs of recovery.
- GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Fraud push the Social Securiry deficit to 35 billion pesetas (higher than forecast in the first quarter of the year).
- Banco Urquijo and IBM open a new era in banking management.
- Spanish BCH to sell to French ELF Aquitaine a 5.8 pertcent in Cepsa
- The governemnt to study a tax to finance national coal industry.
